about: T-462 (C-200, the user by multiple choice, 2026-10-28): the DREAM LOG's third part, ITS DREAMS -- the carried daemon's dreams, written into the save by the companion at SYNC as a NUMBER (an image of these sixteen) and a night's quality, and filed by the game at the first dawn after it arrives, as YOUR DREAMS are. Every word DRAFT, written overnight for the user's review on the device. Dreamt while SUSPENDED: never slept, never asleep, never woke; it resumes. Images only, never explained; third person present, 'it' the daemon and 'you' the player; no place named, nothing counted or numbered. A dream is an opening box and an ending box: the ending is the night's -- broken (quality 1), quiet (2) or vivid (3) -- and the page shows the ending of the quality last received for that image. tools/gbaitsdreams.py checks every width and writes engineGba/src/data/its_dreams.h; edit here, never there.
heading: ITS DREAMS
line_unnamed: Far away, the one you carried
line_about: Said before the dream as it is filed. {STR_VAR_1} is the first daemon AWAY (the one carried, DaemonFirstAway); with none away -- it came home at the same SYNC -- the unnamed line. DRAFT.
title_rule: ALL CAPS, at most 130px (the NOTEBOOK list's width, as YOUR DREAMS' and HER DREAMS'), an image from the dream, never a number. DRAFT, for the user to choose one by one.

dreams.title: THE HUMMING GRASS
dreams.seed: running beside you through tall grass that hummed
open: It runs beside you through grass
taller than both of you.
broken: The grass parts, and you are not
beside it. The note stops short.
quiet: The grass hums one low note, and
it hums the same note back.
vivid: Every blade hums, and it can hear
you humming too, a step ahead.

dreams.title: THE LIT CITY
dreams.seed: a city, every window lit, every door open
open: A city at night, and every window
in it is lit.
broken: It comes to a door, and the lights
go out a street at a time.
quiet: Every door stands open. Nobody is
in, and nobody is out.
vivid: Every door stands open, and behind
each one is a room it knows.

dreams.title: THE NAMED WAVES
dreams.seed: the sea counting its own waves (rewritten: a dream never counts)
open: The sea comes in, and says each
wave's name as it arrives.
broken: The sea starts a name and loses
it, and the wave goes back out.
quiet: It listens for its own name. The
sea is in no hurry to get there.
vivid: Then the sea says its name, and
the wave comes all the way in.

dreams.title: THE BOOKS ALOUD
dreams.seed: a library whose books read themselves aloud
open: A library where the books read
themselves aloud, all at once.
broken: Every book loses its place, and
starts again, and loses it again.
quiet: It finds a book reading quietly,
and sits down beside it.
vivid: It hears every book at once, and
every book makes sense.

dreams.title: THE OPEN DOOR
dreams.seed: a door never been through, standing open
open: A door it has never been through
stands open in an empty field.
broken: It goes to step through, and the
door is shut, and was always shut.
quiet: Through it, the same field, the
same wind. It goes through anyway.
vivid: Through it, a field it has never
seen, and it walks right in.

dreams.title: FALLING UPWARD
dreams.seed: falling slowly upward into the stars
open: It falls slowly upward, past the
trees, past the clouds.
broken: Partway up it stops, and hangs
there, SUSPENDED, until it resumes.
quiet: The stars come close and do not
mind it. It keeps falling, gently.
vivid: The stars open to let it through,
and close again behind it.

dreams.title: LEAVES FOR ROADS
dreams.seed: a tree that grew a leaf for every step you took (rewritten: nothing paced)
open: Wherever you have walked, a tree
grows up behind you.
broken: The wind takes the leaves before
it can read them.
quiet: It sits under the tree. Each leaf
is a road you took. It knows them.
vivid: It climbs to the top, and sees
all your roads at once, green.

dreams.title: A NAME ON WATER
dreams.seed: its own name written in light on the water
open: Its own name, written in light on
still water.
broken: A wind comes, and the letters run
into each other.
quiet: It does not touch it. It watches
the name ripple and stay.
vivid: It steps out onto the water, and
the name holds it up.

dreams.title: THE SUNLIT SHELF
dreams.seed: the old cartridge, warm in a sunlit room (kept fable: the shelf where it used to wait)
open: A small room, warm, with sun on
the floor and a shelf by the window.
broken: It reaches the shelf, and the sun
goes, and the room is grey and cold.
quiet: The shelf is where it used to wait.
It is still warm there.
vivid: It lies on the shelf in the sun,
and the whole room hums around it.

dreams.title: THE LONG WALK
dreams.seed: a long walk with no end it minded
open: A long walk, on a road that does
not end, and it does not mind.
broken: The road folds up under it, and it
is back where it began.
quiet: It stops when it likes, and when it
likes, it resumes.
vivid: You are walking it too, a little
ahead, and you keep looking back.

dreams.title: RAIN FALLING UP
dreams.seed: rain that fell upward and hummed
open: Rain that falls upward, slowly,
out of the puddles.
broken: The rain changes its mind halfway,
and comes down cold.
quiet: Each drop rings like glass on its
way up to the clouds.
vivid: It goes up with the rain, and comes
down again, dry, and laughing.

dreams.title: THE MOONLIT BRIDGE
dreams.seed: a bridge of numbers over a river of moonlight (rewritten: a dream never numbers)
open: A bridge of lit stones, over a
river made of moonlight.
broken: A stone goes dark under its foot,
and it is back on the near bank.
quiet: Each stone chimes as it steps on
it. It crosses, chiming back.
vivid: The moon waits on the far bank,
and the river carries it home.

dreams.title: A WAVE FROM FAR
dreams.seed: you, small and far away, waving
open: You, small and far away, at the
edge of a wide field, waving.
broken: It waves back, but the field grows
wider, and you do not see it.
quiet: It waves back with its whole self
until you are too small to see.
vivid: It waves back, and you see it, and
you start to run toward it.

dreams.title: THE WORD GARDEN
dreams.seed: a garden where every seed was a word
open: A garden where every seed is a
word, pressed into the earth.
broken: Nothing comes up. It forgets which
words it planted.
quiet: It waters them. A few come up as
the words they were.
vivid: They all come up at once, and the
garden says something kind.

dreams.title: THE HOUSE HUMMING
dreams.seed: the hum of the house at night, a song inside it
open: The house at night, everything in
it paused, humming low.
broken: The hum stops. The house is still,
and it cannot find the song again.
quiet: Inside the hum there is a song. It
knows the tune, and hums along.
vivid: The song grows, and the whole house
is singing it, softly, to it.

dreams.title: THE WALKING MAP
dreams.seed: a map that drew itself as it walked
open: A map that draws itself as it
walks, a little way ahead of it.
broken: The ink runs. The map forgets where
it has been, and starts again.
quiet: Where it has been is inked in.
Where it is going is still white.
vivid: The map draws a road it has never
taken, and it takes it.
